VBO:0200256.summary: Sensitive and initially shy, Queenie was a Bulldog–Shar Pei cross whose rescuers described affection once she felt comfortable. Their winter updates recorded short, quiet strolls, sniffing her surroundings and naps under a heat lamp. Familiar visitors could prompt a little happy-feet dance, although loud noises and sudden movements still startled her.
VBO:0200256.shortDescription: Queenie’s rescuers described a sensitive Bulldog–Shar Pei cross who enjoyed gentle strolls and familiar company.
